verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community tip that Elasticsearch's default refresh interval is 1 second and can be tuned. That implies newly indexed documents become searchable within about a second without a full reindex. No first-party docs in the pack describe near-real-time search, and updates and deletes are not addressed at all. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of near-real-time refresh semantics, explicit evidence that updates and deletes become visible without reindexing, hands-on corroboration of visibility latency.

support.subject: As a developer, document adds, updates, and deletes become searchable in near real time without a full reindex

citations.quote: the default refresh interval is 1 second
